children.value: The spray aerator model simulates spray aeration systems used for gas transfer processes in water treatment. It performs gas exchange between water and air through spray nozzles, removing dissolved gases like CO₂ and CH₄ while providing oxygen transfer capabilities.
The spray aerator model inherits from both the base
class, enabling it to handle mass balance calculations and gas transfer processes.
